title: AT&T store worker gets 16 months inside for SIM-swap side hustle
content_md: Connor Jones reports: A former AT&T retail worker who used his system access to hijack customers’ phone numbers for cybercriminals has been sentenced to 16 months in federal prison. Kenneth Carter, 44, carried out the SIM swaps at a store in Portland, Oregon, , allowing the criminals to intercept authentication codes and raid victims’ bank accounts… Source Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/09/13/att-store-worker-gets-16-months-inside-for-sim-swap-side-hustle/
